title: Building Agents and Multi-step Workflows
description: Chain reasoning, tool use, and retrieval into an agent that completes multi-step tasks.
learningOutcomes: Explain the difference between a chain and an agent
Design an agent loop with a clear stopping condition
Debug an agent that goes off the rails

lessons.title: Agents vs. Fixed Chains
lessons.description: When to hard-code steps and when to let the model plan them.
learningObjectives: Distinguish a fixed pipeline from an agent loop
Identify tasks that don't need an agent
Explain the cost/reliability tradeoff of agents

lessons.title: Designing the Agent Loop
lessons.description: Plan, act, observe, repeat — with a stopping condition that actually stops.
learningObjectives: Cap steps and cost per task
Detect and break out of repetition loops

lessons.title: State and Multi-step Memory
lessons.description: Track what an agent has already tried across steps.
learningObjectives: Maintain working state across agent steps
Summarize history instead of resending everything
Avoid state that silently grows unbounded

lessons.title: Debugging Agent Behavior
lessons.description: Make an agent's decisions inspectable when it does something wrong.
learningObjectives: Log every agent decision and tool call
Add guardrails after a failure mode is found
